nutritional intervention is important in the management of cystic fibrosis, as it is associated with improved survival.

nutritional intervention in CF should be considered as an integral part of the treatment of the disease, and that nutritional intervention should be started early in the course of the disease, preferably at the time of diagnosis.

nutritional intervention should be started early in patients with CF, even if they do not have overt malnutrition, and that nutritional intervention should not only focus on increasing energy intake, but also on improving the nutritional status of the patient, including increasing the intake of protein and essential fatty acids.
